description: This file contains functions and types for determining and managing the Quality of Service (QoS) class of Kubernetes pods, including resource list processing and QoS classification logic.

classes.name: QOSList
classes.description: A map type representing pairs of resource names and QoS classes.

methods.name: isSupportedQoSComputeResource
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is supported for QoS computation.

methods.name: GetPodQOS
methods.description: Returns the QoS class of a given pod, using the pod's status or computing it if not set.

methods.name: ComputePodQOS
methods.description: Determines the QoS class of a pod based on its resource requests and limits, considering pod-level resources and container resources.
